description: Given a U.S.-listed company's stock ticker or SEC CIK, returns its EDGAR profile (legal name, tickers, exchanges, SIC industry, state of incorporation, fiscal year end), its latest annual financials from XBRL (revenue, operating and net income, diluted EPS, assets, liabilities, equity, cash, shares outstanding, each with period and source filing) and its recent filings with 8-K item titles and document links. Companies only. Not charged if not found. Costs $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, eip155:8453); failures are not charged.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, digits only (give ticker or cik)

filings.description: How many recent filings to list, 0-25 (default 10)

forms.description: Optional filter, comma-separated form types, e.g. 10-K,8-K

ticker.description: Stock ticker, e.g. AAPL (give ticker or cik)

name: sec_company
title: SEC EDGAR company profile
